description: Ace to Five of Wands in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for each card, how they form a story, and how to use them in a tarot spread.
lede: The Ace to Five of Wands cover the start of a venture, from the first spark to the friction that follows. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.

faces.alt: Five original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row, in order: Ace of Wands, Two of Wands, Three of Wands, Four of Wands and Five of Wands. Each shows its number and a wand icon with the card name beneath. No scenes are drawn.
faces.caption: Ace to Five of Wands in order, shown as simple number-and-suit card faces.
